correction.overgeneralization: The previous calculation treated the sewing phase t and quarter-turn phase g as independent and therefore found a chamber sign -/+ Re(t/g).
correction.source_lock: In the canonical Clifford construction they are not independent: S_T=[[0,T*],[T,0]] and F_C=J S_T. On a scalar Tate fiber T=g, so the quarter-turn uses exactly the sewing phase.
correction.green_convention: With the source convention J=diag(I,-I), Lambda_+=Graph(T), not the opposite-sign J used in the scout.

exact_identity.selected_crossing: for lambda in Lambda_+=ker(S_T-I)=Graph(T), [lambda,F_C mu]_J=<lambda,J F_C mu>=<lambda,S_T mu>=<lambda,mu>

alternation_reinterpreted.meaning: the sign alternation is exactly the +/- chirality grading, not a missing arbitrary orientation choice
alternation_reinterpreted.scope: the positive apex uses the ordered Lambda_+ to Lambda_- crossing; it does not require all four cyclic edges to be positive simultaneously

typing.T: acts on H_resp and is source-derived from Fourier response
typing.F_C: acts on H_resp direct-sum H_resp and is functorially induced after graphing
typing.no_external_identification: T need not be identified or conjugated with F_C

remaining_gate: Only relative Evans membership remains: construct Tr_mod with P_- Tr_mod in tau O(H_resp direct-sum H_resp), where P_-=(I-S_T)/2. Absolute unchanged-trace membership is already numerically hostile.
verification_note: The existing symbolic checker could not execute because SymPy is absent, but its displayed matrices give the same exact scalar specialization F=Z R and phase lock T=gamma.
conclusion: The source already contains the required orientation datum as Green sign times sewing chirality. The canonical phase lock removes the arbitrary Maslov chamber. Positive complement construction is closed; the nonformal problem is the divisor-preserving modified Evans map into its positive chirality graph.
